resources.string: Keep calls on your chosen Bluetooth device
Start by allowing nearby Bluetooth device and phone-account access.
Approve the selected call device once so Android can allow protected call routing.
Select the paired Bluetooth device that should handle calls.
Setup is complete. Enable automatic routing when you are ready.
Calls will use your selected device
The app is ready and will make a bounded routing request when an eligible call starts.
Complete the required setup steps below to enable automation.
Automatic routing is off. You can test once before enabling it.
Automatic routing is on. Safety checks still run for every call.
Not connected — automatic routing will wait
Not detected yet — automatic routing will wait
Needed to identify paired call devices and verify eligible cellular calls.

Bluetooth access lets the app identify your already-paired call device. Phone-account access is used only to verify that a call is cellular and not an emergency call. The app does not read contacts, call history, or audio.
Approve the selected device in Android’s one-time companion-device dialog.
Choose the preferred Bluetooth call device first.
Confirm the selected call device in Android’s dialog.
Authorization was cancelled. You can try again at any time.
Android’s companion-device authorization is unavailable on this device.

Android did not grant call access through the in-app device approval. Run this fallback command from an authorized local ADB shell using Wireless Debugging. If you use a computer, prefix it with “adb shell”.

%1$s

After running it, return here and the status will refresh automatically.
No device selected. Pair the car or headset in Android Bluetooth settings first.
While parked, start a normal non-emergency call and tap the button below. This one-shot test keeps all safety and device checks enabled.
None — do not retry after the initial request
Leave this unset for the safest behavior. When selected, only this device may trigger limited retry attempts during the first four seconds of a call.
Battery settings (only if calls are missed)
Use this only if real tests show missed calls while the phone is idle. A battery exemption does not guarantee Telecom binding, and the app will not change this setting automatically.
Private by design: no internet, audio recording, contacts, or call-log access.
Reference build • Test only while parked
